snippet.title: Bobble Shop Simulator Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4069170/Bobble_Shop_Simulator/

Coming soon - Bobble Shop Simulator

Take control of your very own bobble head shop. Sell, buy, trade, and repair a large variety of bobble heads and related merchandise. Stock shelves, hire employees, and grow your business. Pay attention though, as these bobble heads sometimes have a mind of their own.
